fullPassage: As one of many examples of complexity of motivationally anchored instruction, motivation is governed to a large extent by emotion. A person working at a task feels frustrated and stops. Another person working at a task feels joy and continues. But what brings out a response of frustration or joy may differ across cultures, because cultures differ in their definitions of novelty, hazard, opportunity, gratification, and so forth. It is also quite possible for another person with a different set of cultural beliefs to feel frustrated at a task and yet continue with further determination. Depending on the cultural groups with which a person identifies, illness, for example, may be understood from the perspective of germs, God, anxiety, chance, or one's moral failure, and a person's emotional response to illness will reflect these beliefs. Cultural groups vary in their beliefs about the meaning of emotional experiences, expressions, and behaviors.

det.tip: anchored = 닻으로 고정된 → motivationally anchored instruction = 동기부여에 뿌리내린 교수법. ↔ drifting(표류)

questions.passage:
(A) The artist studied <u>perspective</u> carefully before painting the long hallway to make the far end look smaller.

(B) Illness may be understood from the <u>perspective</u> of germs, God, anxiety, chance, or one's moral failure.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 perspective의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) perspective = 원근법(시각 예술 기법, 먼 것을 작게 그리는 기법), (B) perspective = 관점/시각(어떤 입장에서 바라보는가)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 관점 — (B) 관점: (A)는 그림에서 먼 곳을 작게 그리는 '원근법' 기법 맥락
❌ ② (A) 원근법 — (B) 원근법: (B)는 질병을 세균/신의 입장에서 이해하는 '관점' 맥락
✅ ③ (A) 원근법 — (B) 관점: (A) = 미술 기법, (B) = 시각/입장
❌ ④ (A) 관점 — (B) 원근법: (A)가 관점, (B)가 원근법이면 맥락 반대
det.tip: perspective 두 의미: ① 원근법(미술: 거리감을 표현하는 기법) ② 관점/시각(viewpoint: 어떤 입장에서 바라봄)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a feeling of pleasure and happiness that you get when you achieve something or when something that you wanted to happen does happen"

det.korean: gratification(만족감/충족감) — 원하는 것을 성취하거나 바라던 일이 이루어질 때 느끼는 기쁨과 행복감
det.analysis:
❌ ① frustration: 좌절감 — 원하는 것을 얻지 못할 때의 감정
❌ ② anxiety: 불안감 — 걱정과 두려움의 감정
✅ ③ gratification: 만족감 — 정의 일치. 성취 시 느끼는 기쁨과 행복
❌ ④ determination: 결단력 — 감정이 아닌 의지/태도
det.tip: gratification = 원하던 것을 얻을 때의 만족감/충족감 (즉각적 만족 = instant gratification)

questions.passage: Depending on the cultural groups with which a person __________ (identify), illness, for example, may be understood from the perspective of germs, God, anxiety, chance, or one's moral failure.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

a person __________ (identify) — 관계절 안에서 현재 시제, 3인칭 단수

det.korean: identify(동사원형) → identifies(3인칭 단수 현재): 관계절 'with which a person identifies'에서 주어 a person은 3인칭 단수, 현재 시제이므로 -(e)s를 붙임
det.analysis: 관계절 내 주어 'a person'은 3인칭 단수 → 현재 시제 + -(e)s 필수. identify → identifies.
det.tip: 관계절 동사 수 일치: a person (3인칭 단수) + 현재 시제 → identify + es = identifies

overlay.excerptSentences: Depending on the cultural groups with which a person __________ (identify), illness, for example, may be understood from the perspective of germs, God, anxiety, chance, or one's moral failure.

questions.passage: It is also quite possible for another person with a different set of cultural beliefs to feel __________ (frustrate) at a task and yet continue with further determination.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

to feel __________ (frustrate) at a task

det.korean: frustrate(동사원형) → frustrated(과거분사/감정 형용사): feel + 감정 형용사 구조. '사람이 감정을 느끼는' 경우 과거분사 형태 사용
det.analysis: feel + p.p. (감정 수동): frustrate(좌절시키다) → frustrated(좌절감을 느끼는). 사람이 느끼는 감정 = 과거분사.
det.tip: feel frustrated(좌절감을 느끼다) — 감정 동사의 수동형: frustrate → frustrated (cf. frustrating은 사물/상황 묘사)

overlay.excerptSentences: It is also quite possible for another person with a different set of cultural beliefs to feel __________ (frustrate) at a task and yet continue with further determination.

questions.passage: As one of many examples of complexity of motivationally anchored instruction, motivation is governed to a large extent by emotion. A person working at a task feels frustrated and stops. Another person working at a task feels joy and continues. But what brings out a response of frustration or joy may __________, because cultures differ in their definitions of novelty, hazard, opportunity, gratification, and so forth. It is also quite possible for another person with a different set of cultural beliefs to feel frustrated at a task and yet continue with further determination. Depending on the cultural groups with which a person identifies, illness, for example, may be understood from the perspective of germs, God, anxiety, chance, or one's moral failure, and a person's emotional response to illness will reflect these beliefs. Cultural groups vary in their beliefs about the meaning of emotional experiences, expressions, and behaviors.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: differ across cultures(문화에 따라 다르다) — 좌절이나 기쁨을 유발하는 반응이 '문화에 따라 다르다'는 것이 본문 핵심 주장
det.analysis:
❌ ① are shared universally: 보편적으로 공유됨 — 본문은 문화 차이를 강조, 보편성 주장과 반대
❌ ② depend on individual character: 개인 성격에 달림 — 본문은 '개인'이 아닌 '문화'에 따른 차이 강조
❌ ③ remain constant over time: 시간이 지나도 일정함 — 변화가 아닌 문화간 차이가 핵심
✅ ④ differ across cultures: 원문 일치 — cultures differ in their definitions of novelty, hazard...
det.tip: what brings out frustration or joy may differ across cultures — 감정 반응 유발 요인의 문화적 차이가 논지

questions.passage: As one of many examples of complexity of motivationally anchored instruction, motivation is governed to a large extent by emotion. A person working at a task feels frustrated and stops. Another person working at a task feels joy and continues. But what brings out a response of frustration or joy may differ across cultures, because cultures differ in their definitions of novelty, hazard, opportunity, gratification, and so forth. It is also quite possible for another person with a different set of cultural beliefs to feel frustrated at a task and yet continue with further determination. Depending on the cultural groups with which a person identifies, illness, for example, may be understood from the perspective of germs, God, anxiety, chance, or one's moral failure, and a person's emotional response to illness will reflect these beliefs. Cultural groups vary in their beliefs about the meaning of __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: emotional experiences, expressions, and behaviors(감정적 경험, 표현, 행동) — 문화 집단이 이것들의 의미에 대한 믿음에서 차이가 있다는 본문 마지막 문장의 핵심 표현
det.analysis:
✅ ① emotional experiences, expressions, and behaviors: 원문 일치 — Cultural groups vary in their beliefs about the meaning of emotional experiences, expressions, and behaviors
❌ ② physical health and disease symptoms: 신체 건강 증상 — 본문은 '감정적' 측면에 초점, 신체 증상 열거는 없음
❌ ③ traditional customs and social norms: 전통 관습과 사회 규범 — 본문에 등장하지 않는 표현
❌ ④ individual personality and genetic traits: 개인 성격과 유전적 특성 — 본문은 문화 집단 차이 강조, 개인/유전 요인 아님
det.tip: Cultural groups vary in their beliefs about the meaning of _____ — 마지막 문장 핵심 3요소: experiences, expressions, behaviors
